hero.title: We started with a question about chemicals
hero.body: Clothing sits against your skin for sixteen hours a day. We thought it should be the safest thing you own — so we rebuilt the supply chain to make that true.

story.title: Clean from seed to skin
paragraphs: We began in a garage in Los Angeles with one t-shirt and a list of ingredients we refused to use. No conventional cotton, no formaldehyde finishes, no per- and polyfluoroalkyl treatments, no untraceable dye houses.

Twelve years later the list hasn't changed. What has changed is the scale: a full range of essentials for women and men, grown on certified organic farms, knitted and sewn by partners we visit in person, and tested at the finished-garment stage rather than the fibre stage.
We publish what we find — including the things we haven't fixed yet. Progress is a direction, not a badge.

items.title: Organic cotton
items.body: Long-staple, rain-fed where possible, certified to a recognised organic standard.

items.title: Organic stretch knit
items.body: Cotton blended with a small percentage of elastane for recovery, knitted in Portugal.

items.title: Brushed organic fleece
items.body: Loop-back fleece brushed twice for loft without shedding.

items.title: Waffle & rib
items.body: Textured knits that hide creases and dry quickly — our travel staples.

items.title: Natural dye programme
items.body: A growing range dyed with plant-derived pigment instead of synthetic colourant.

factories.title: Made where we can see it
factories.body: Cutting, sewing and finishing happen in audited partner facilities. We visit each one, publish the audit summary, and set a wage benchmark we're accountable to.

items.title: Fibre traceability
items.body: Mapping every farm in our organic cotton programme back to plot level.

items.title: Take-back & repair
items.body: A repair service and a take-back scheme so worn pieces become new yarn.

items.title: Packaging
items.body: Plastic-free mailers, already live; plastic-free polybags at factory level, in progress.

items.title: Water
items.body: Closed-loop dyeing at our primary knit partner, targeting 60% water reuse.

items.q: How do I find my size?
items.a: Our pieces run true to size. Check the size guide on each product page, or message us your height and usual size and we'll recommend.

items.q: How should I wash organic cotton?
items.a: Cold wash, mild detergent, no fabric softener. Tumble low or line dry to keep the fibres intact for longer.

sportsBra.title: Organic Jersey Sports Bra
sportsBra.description: A seamless-feel bra cut from our organic jersey with a wide underband and a bonded neckline that stays put through a full workout. No wires, no scratchy tags, no digging straps.
sportsBra.material: 92% certified organic cotton, 8% elastane. Machine wash cold, lay flat to dry.
sportsBra.care: Cold wash · No softener · Line dry

midiLegging.title: Organic Jersey Midi Legging
midiLegging.description: Our most reordered legging. High-rise with a bonded waistband that doesn't fold over, a hidden key pocket, and a knit with genuine recovery so it holds its shape past the first hour.
midiLegging.material: 92% certified organic cotton, 8% elastane. Machine wash cold inside out, tumble low.
midiLegging.care: Cold wash · Inside out · Tumble low

crossoverLegging.title: Organic Jersey Crossover Legging
crossoverLegging.description: A crossover waistband that sits flat against the hip instead of rolling, in the same recovery knit as our midi legging. Full length, opaque in every colourway.
crossoverLegging.material: 92% certified organic cotton, 8% elastane. Machine wash cold, tumble low.

highNeckTank.title: Organic Jersey High Neck Tank
highNeckTank.description: A close-fitting tank with a standing collar that layers cleanly under jackets or works on its own. Cut long enough to stay tucked.
highNeckTank.material: 95% certified organic cotton, 5% elastane. Machine wash cold, line dry.

longSleeveTop.title: Organic Jersey Long Sleeve Top
longSleeveTop.description: A slim long sleeve with a neat crew neck, set-in sleeves and cuffs that keep their shape. Works as a base layer in winter and on its own in spring.
longSleeveTop.material: 95% certified organic cotton, 5% elastane. Machine wash cold, tumble low.

zipHoodie.title: Organic Fleece Zip Hoodie
zipHoodie.description: An oversized hoodie in twice-brushed organic fleece with a full-length metal zip, a lined hood and deep welt pockets. Heavy enough for cold mornings, soft enough to sleep in.
zipHoodie.material: 100% certified organic cotton fleece, 420gsm. Machine wash cold, tumble low.
zipHoodie.care: Cold wash · Tumble low · No bleach

relaxedSweatpant.title: Organic Fleece Relaxed Sweatpant
relaxedSweatpant.description: A relaxed sweatpant with a flat drawcord waist, side pockets and a slight taper at the ankle so it doesn't bunch. Cut generous through the thigh.
relaxedSweatpant.material: 100% certified organic cotton fleece, 420gsm. Machine wash cold, tumble low.

poloSweatshirt.title: Organic Fleece Polo Sweatshirt
poloSweatshirt.description: A sweatshirt with a proper collar and a short placket, cut boxy in the same brushed fleece as the hoodie. Smart enough for a meeting, soft enough for a Sunday.
poloSweatshirt.material: 100% certified organic cotton fleece, 400gsm. Machine wash cold, tumble low.

scoopBra.title: Organic Jersey Scoop Bra
scoopBra.description: A light-support bra with a scooped neckline and thin adjustable straps, built for low-impact days and layering under open necklines.
scoopBra.material: 92% certified organic cotton, 8% elastane. Hand wash or cold machine wash, lay flat to dry.

croppedSweatpant.title: Organic Fleece Cropped Sweatpant
croppedSweatpant.description: The relaxed sweatpant, cropped to hit just below the ankle. Same brushed fleece, same flat drawcord waist, slightly shorter for warmer days.
croppedSweatpant.material: 100% certified organic cotton fleece, 400gsm. Machine wash cold, tumble low.

socks3.title: Organic Cotton Crew Socks — 3 Pack
socks3.description: A three-pack of mid-weight crew socks in combed organic cotton with a cushioned footbed and a ribbed cuff that doesn't slide down.
socks3.material: 85% certified organic cotton, 12% nylon, 3% elastane. Machine wash warm, tumble low.

halfZip.title: Organic Waffle Collar Half-Zip
halfZip.description: A textured waffle half-zip with a stand collar and a short metal zip. Packs small, dries fast, and looks better after a few washes than it did new.
halfZip.material: 100% certified organic cotton waffle knit. Machine wash cold, line dry.
